visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian man wearing a black t-shirt, black baseball cap, and glasses stands against a vibrant red and blue gradient studio background. He speaks expressively, gesturing with his hands towards the camera lens, appearing energetic and engaging. (2) A clean white screen transition features a floating red and blue 'm' cube logo for Mercari. The man's upper body remains visible in a small circular inset at the bottom corner as the transition completes, leading into the app demonstration. (3) The screen displays a high-density vertical scrolling interface of the Mercari app. Numerous product listings for anime figures, trading cards, and collectibles are shown with prices listed in New Taiwan Dollars (NTD) on a white background. (4) A detailed product page for a yellow one-eyed horned monster figure is showcased. Multiple preview thumbnails of the toy are visible, along with price information and 'Add to Cart' or 'Buy Now' buttons at the bottom. (5) The man is shown looking through glass display cases filled with various colorful anime figurines in an indoor environment. He points at specific items, illustrating his personal interest in the hobby before returning to the studio setup. (6) A fast-paced montage of promotional screens for the "11.11 Unboxing Festival" appears. Various red and yellow banners announce 10% off for new users and 30% off site-wide, with large typography and energetic graphic layouts. (7) The man holds a large, plain cardboard shipping box with a shipping label, smiling broadly and pointing at it to symbolize a successful delivery. He then finishes by pointing both fingers directly at the viewer in a call to action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic male voice begins with high pitch variability, speaking clearly and excitedly. Upbeat electronic BGM with a strong rhythmic pulse (approx. 128 BPM) starts immediately. A sharp "whoosh" SFX accompanies the first transition. (2) Narration continues at a fast pace, describing app benefits. BGM remains constant. Digital "click" and "pop" sound effects are heard as screen recordings of the app are shown, punctuating the visual item selections. (3) The speaker's tone remains friendly and professional. Subtle "ding" SFX emphasize key features mentioned, such as "International version" and "easy ordering." The music maintains a bright, major-mode energy. (4) Vocal arousal increases slightly while announcing the "11.11 Festival" promotions. A brief stinger or riser effect builds tension before listing specific discount percentages. Multiple "pop" SFX occur during the coupon montage. (5) Final phase features a concluding call to action. The voice is authoritative yet welcoming. The BGM reaches a steady loop. A final "whoosh" and "impact" SFX end the clip as the man points at the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a promotional advertisement for the Mercari app in Taiwan, focusing on its utility for buying limited-edition Japanese hobby items. It highlights current 11.11 shopping festival discounts, free shipping offers, and provides a personal referral code for extra savings.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of app features, tutorial-like screen recordings, and a personal promotional code (MRJOEW11).
